method.text: Montserrat outlines from kit.text_paths; style/size/tracking/x/baseline fitted per run by mask IoU (alpha = per-pixel unmix of bg->apparent ink), shared style+size inside obvious groups, then per-glyph manual kerning (Illustrator kerning, 1/1000 em, at the given character index).
method.iou: binary IoU of alpha>=0.5 (original) vs coverage>=0.5 (exact raster of the fitted outlines) at 1x; iou_render uses the VectorCraft render of the SVG instead of the raster; iou_soft = sum(min)/sum(max).
method.colors: large-glyph interiors / least squares through a JPEG 4:2:0 chroma model of the original (it is quality-100 4:2:0, so thin features lose chroma, not luma); snapped to the palette within dE2000 4.
